scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:turnstone: PORT=${PORT:-5000} BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/party-game run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build:client
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter @workspace/engine --filter @workspace/shared --filter @workspace/security --if-present run typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint artifacts/party-game artifacts/api-server/src lib/engine lib/shared lib/security lib/db/src tests e2e scripts/src *.ts *.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check docs tests e2e artifacts/party-game/src artifacts/api-server/src lib/engine lib/shared lib/security lib/db/src scripts/src package.json scripts/package.json artifacts/api-server/package.json lib/db/package.json
scripts.test:server-coverage: vitest run tests/http.test.ts tests/env.test.ts tests/database.integration.test.ts tests/late-invites.integration.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --coverage.enabled --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.include=**/app.ts --coverage.include=**/realtime.ts --coverage.include=**/deadline-scheduler.ts --coverage.include=**/config/env.ts --coverage.include=**/middlewares/security.ts --coverage.thresholds.lines=85
scripts.test:accessibility: bash scripts/browser-runtime.sh pnpm exec tsx tests/support/lighthouse.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:build && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:property && pnpm run test:server-coverage && pnpm run test:scenario-workers && pnpm run test:scenarios && pnpm run test:smoke && pnpm run test:accessibility && pnpm run audit
scripts.verify:full: pnpm run verify && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run scenarios:full
